name: Foothold Citadel
summary: At Foothold Citadel, Theramore's guards prepare to defend the island. The fortress holds the Alliance command and barracks on Theramore Isle, overlooking the settlement.

sections.title: Heart of the Theramore Guard
sections.body: Foothold Citadel holds the Alliance defense within Theramore Isle's stone walls. Captain Garran Vimes and Commander Samaul lead the Theramore Guard from its halls. Field medics, logistics officers and quartermasters work beside them. Guards patrol and drill, preparing Lady Jaina Proudmoore's forces for threats from the surrounding swamplands.

sections.title: Echoes of the Admiral's Fall
sections.body: Foothold Citadel recalls the early days of Theramore. Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore seized the city to wage his personal crusade against the Horde, and the fortress became the place of his final stand. Thrall's allied force broke through the citadel under Rexxar, a half-ogre warrior, and struck down the Admiral. The fortress has been repaired, though the bloody conflict is remembered.

faq.q: What is Foothold Citadel used for?
faq.answer: Foothold Citadel is the Theramore Guard's headquarters and barracks. Command officers, tactical planners, training facilities and logistics staff work there, along with the local paymaster and medical personnel.

faq.q: What happened to Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore here?
faq.answer: During the conflict after the Third War, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore seized Theramore to wage war on the young Horde. A combined force led by the champion Rexxar stormed the citadel and killed the Admiral in his own headquarters.

faq.q: Who is currently in charge at Foothold Citadel?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes and Commander Samaul oversee the garrison's daily patrols and regional security under Lady Jaina Proudmoore's authority.

faq.q: Can I receive medical aid inside the citadel?
faq.answer: Yes. Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen lives inside Foothold Citadel. He tends wounded guardsmen and teaches Alliance travelers advanced field medicine and triage.

angles.text: Foothold Citadel is the Alliance's main military post in southern Kalimdor. Its officers coordinate defense against swamp beasts, Grimtotem marauders and watchful Horde scouts.
The Horde remembers Foothold Citadel as the place where Rexxar and Thrall ended Grand Admiral Proudmoore's campaign to protect Durotar.
